era_unit: weekly validation-file eras; uniform-width zero-padded strings

archive_selection_consumed.note: Consumed for model selection by the archived Ender program (experiments/README.md): do not reuse for post-hoc selection evidence.

archive_observed.note: Observed by the archived Ender21 confirmation and Ender22-27 evaluations; usable as development data but not a substitute confirmation cohort.

mmc_capable.basis: Published v5.3 meta_model.parquet coverage at freeze; MMC and weighted-score development reads are only defined here.

dev.train_file_note: train.parquet eras (0001-0574) are outside this validation partition; eras 0301-0574 are archive-selection-consumed per the research ledger.

gap.embargo_rationale: At least 8 full weekly eras separate DEV from HOLDOUT. DEV end 1222 to HOLDOUT start 1231 is a 9-week era-date spacing (63 days): greater than the 22-day forward window of the current 20D2L payout target and greater than the 62-day forward window of a 60D2L target, so no DEV target window overlaps any holdout era even under the announced Ender-60 cutover.

holdout.post_archive_preference: Holdout begins immediately after era 1230, the last era observed by the archived research program, so every holdout era is post-archive.
holdout.policy: Fewer than 13 suitable holdout eras exist (currently 0 fully resolved for target_ender_20, whose resolution frontier is era 1227), so the holdout is marked ACCUMULATING. The 13-era requirement is not weakened. No post-hoc selection on the holdout. Round 0 grants no authority to score the holdout.

smoke_slice.purpose: Round-0 plumbing smoke only: inside DEV, inside published meta-model coverage, fully resolved for the payout target, and strictly pre-embargo/pre-holdout. Smoke metrics are plumbing evidence, not a candidate result, and rank nothing.

hygiene.holdout_reads: Holdout eras were touched only for schema/era enumeration and null-count metadata proving target availability; no holdout target values were opened, summarized, or scored.
hygiene.selection: No post-hoc selection on the final holdout, ever.
